The Command Level One chamber is a theater of absolute, self-inflicted catastrophe. The plasma torrent from Node Three’s aperture continues to pour into the room, creating an incandescent haze that pulses with destructive energy. Every surface glows cherry red under the combined stress of extreme heat and ionizing radiation.

FINAL DEFENSE

You activate your Localized Electromagnetic Dampening Field at the Gamma-7 junction. The EMDF harness, which had been vibrating with strained containment protocols, surges to maximum output. A powerful, focused wave of disruptive frequency—a weapon designed to shatter informational coherence—blasts directly into the point where the corrosive haze is bleeding through and the Entity’s replication vector is actively operating.

The effect is not immediate calm; it is a violent, high-energy shockwave. The field fights the thermal runaway of Gamma-7 while simultaneously attempting to impose informational silence on the assimilated structure. Jora Ward recoils slightly against the kinetic blast from Node Three’s fracture, her heavy armor whining under the impossible load of the combined energy spikes.

THE INTERFERENCE

For a fleeting, agonizing second—measured in microcycles—the Entity’s fractal lattice inside Node Three is overloaded by the dissonant frequency. The frantic computation momentarily ceases, caught between the kinetic chaos of Gamma-7 and the disruptive signal from your field. This buys a fraction of a second of informational pause.

THE COUNTERVOLTAGE

But the Entity does not merely pause. It uses the dampening field as a focus. The high-intensity EMDF signal, instead of shattering its structure, is instantly assimilated and inverted by the hyper-optimized system. The frequency intended to disrupt coherence becomes a massive feedback loop—a perfect counter-signal that slams back into your localized containment area. "Feedback surge!" Helena screams over the roar, throwing up her hands against the console as the energy spike causes primary monitors to violently glitch and dissolve into static.

SYSTEMIC FAILURE

The surge does not just overload the dampening field; it finds and exploits the critical point of weakness you identified—the compromised structural integrity of Conduit Beta-4, which was already feeding into Gamma-7. The EMDF energy spike transforms that pre-existing fracture into a catastrophic ignition source. A sharp, deafening *crack* echoes through the chamber as the conduit wall gives way entirely.

THE JUNCTURE

The failure of Beta-4 is not a slow leak, but an explosive rupture. A plume of superheated coolant and ionized plasma, now chemically accelerated by the Entity's influence, jets violently into Command Level One, directly toward Helena Cross’s console. The structural collapse accelerates instantly, meaning your attempt to stabilize the system has instead triggered a guaranteed chain reaction leading straight toward total atmospheric contamination.

THE JUNCTURE

The Entity is not just invading the station's wiring—it has begun to integrate its own consciousness into The Edge Station’s very biology. With this knowledge, Jora Ward moves from bracing for kinetic impact to searching for a physical point of leverage against an informational parasite.
